app.heading: Swift Agents app
app.body1: The Swift Agent app enables businesses to engage with customers directly through their mobile devices.
app.body2: Users can communicate seamlessly, update their profiles, and interact with AI agents for tasks such as retrieving OTPs for their assigned accounts.

sdk.heading: Swift Agents SDK
sdk.body1: The Swift Agent SDK is designed for seamless integration into mobile applications, enhancing customer service capabilities.
sdk.body2: This allows customers to effortlessly communicate with agents directly through their mobile devices, ensuring a more efficient and responsive support experience.
